title: Considered work,
built around your practice.
services.lead: For health and wellness practitioners ready to invest in how their practice shows up.
services.body: Every practice is at a different stage. Some need a website that finally does their work justice. Some need a brand that feels aligned before anything else. Some are ready to be found by the right people, in search and in AI results. Bluebay offers a considered path for each.
services.closing: Not sure where to start? Let’s talk it through together.

about.gap: You’ve built something meaningful, but turning that into a digital presence that feels as true as it is professional is where many practices get stuck.
about.gap_strong: We’re here to bridge that gap.
about.circle_image: Soft wave rolling onto the shore at dawn
meet_body: For fifteen years, I’ve built the websites behind busy online businesses: the checkouts, client dashboards and personalized pages that millions of people use every day. I’ve led teams, mentored developers and worked alongside designers and product strategists to build things that feel simple to use.

Now I bring that experience to health and wellness practitioners. Your website is where a new client decides whether to trust you, so it needs to be clear, fast and kind to the person on the other side of the screen.

When we work together, you get a site that loads quickly, reads beautifully on a phone and guides people toward booking with you. You also get a partner who explains each step in plain language, so you feel at ease from the first conversation to launch day.
about.meet_image_bg: Ocean wave rolling onto white sand
about.meet_image: Portrait of the Bluebay Agency founder
about.approach_lead: We don’t believe in one-size-fits-all anything.
about.approach_body: Our process is collaborative, intentional, and grounded in your practice. We listen closely to understand the heart of your work, then build from there. Every design choice is made with purpose, nothing generic, nothing trend-driven for its own sake.
about.approach_blend_post: to create brands and websites that don’t just look good, they feel right.
approach_points: Thoughtful strategy rooted in your goals
Intuitive design that reflects who you are
Systems and structure that support your growth
feel_body: We listen like a partner, think like a strategist, and design with care. Grounded and considered, refined yet approachable, Bluebay brings a calm clarity to the often-overwhelming world of digital presence.
Our clients come to us ready for something more aligned, and leave with a digital presence that feels like them, and works for them.
about.feel_image: Calm coastal horizon under a soft cloudy sky
about.contact_body: Ready for a website, brand, or search visibility that feels like you? Share a few details about your practice and goals, and we’ll follow up to plan your next step.
